[SWS_CM_10222] Setting the size of the length field for arrays
Upstream requirements:
RS_CM_00201, RS_CM_00202, RS_CM_00211
⌈
The serializing SOME/IP network binding shall write the size (in bytes) of the serial-
ized array (without the size of the length field) into the length field.
⌋
The layout of arrays with dynamic length is shown in 7.7 and Figure 7.8 where
L_1
and
L_2
denote the length in bytes. The serialization of one- and multi-dimensional
dynamic length arrays is described in the next two subchapters.
One-dimensional
A one-dimensional array carries a number of elements of the same type.
